entries.anchor: Aggregate Step 2a: Integration Review Selection — `interaction` or `full`
entries.rationale: ai-dossier#928 / #770 operator decision 2026-09-29. The sched batch tail runs review-issue in aggregate mode (batch-b-20260929-01-tail.log), so the rule lives here; batch-integrate Step 5 delegates to it. Evidence: b-20260929-01 ran 6 dimension agents over members that were all already full-tier reviewed.

entries.anchor: Aggregate Step 4: Validity Gate, Dedupe, Apply Serially, Commit and Push, ONE Gate
entries.rationale: ai-dossier#920: the tail left 16 gated review-fix files uncommitted and ended its session while polling gate 2; three gate.batch runs for one batch. Commit+push before the gate, foreground in-turn wait, one gate per distinct tree (START_TREE / gate_tree reuse).

entries.anchor: Gate discipline — one gate per distinct tree, over committed code, in this turn (#920, #928).
entries.rationale: Item 4 recorded gate=capability-unavailable and moved on for any capability-unavailable, so a gate.batch that declined the rebased/fixed tree let the batch ship unverified (ai-dossier#1284). It now distinguishes a decline (non-null exit_code, BLOCK reason=gate-declined) from an undeclared capability (exit_code null).
